entries.title: Clearer plans with switchable decisions
entries.description: Studio's plan card leads with the question, a short summary and the decisions that shape the answer: how sectors and regions are counted, whether multilateral spending is included, gross or net flows, and how phrases such as "major donors" are read. Defaults follow OECD counting conventions, and each answer ends with a "Counted as" line. Each decision can be switched in one click, on the plan card before a run or from chips under the answer afterwards, and the figure is recalculated without a new search. Plans list each decision once and take about half as long, and Studio prepares the data while you review the plan.

entries.title: New analytical operations
entries.description: Studio can give one figure across every row, join tables whose key columns have different names, and compute each donor's share of a pooled total.

entries.title: Several clarifying questions at once
entries.description: When a question is ambiguous, Studio can ask up to three clarifying questions in one pause and keeps your answers in the conversation.

entries.title: Daily Studio limits
entries.description: Studio allows 5 prompts a day for guests and 75 for signed-in users.

entries.title: Faster and more reliable answers
entries.description: Reduce the time Studio takes to find data and complete an analysis. Improve how it asks for clarification and handles failed steps.

entries.title: Saved reproducible analyses
entries.description: Save and download an analysis with its method, data versions, and calculations, then rerun it or use it as the starting point for further work.

entries.title: More analytical operations
entries.description: Add new analytical operations to support a wider range of development finance questions.

entries.title: More development finance methods
entries.description: Apply additional documented approaches to aid, debt, and health-financing questions, with assumptions, source guidance, and methodological choices available for review.

entries.title: More model and provider options
entries.description: Support additional AI models and inference providers for DFO analysis.

entries.title: Adjustable analysis depth
entries.description: Choose a quick answer or a more thorough analysis for a complex question, with the effect on response time explained before starting.

entries.title: Account usage
entries.description: See the AI usage available to your account and how much has been used.
